dz: 中国上空发生日食,是人类历史上最早记载的日食之一,据报道导致两名天文学家被处决而未能预测.
de: A solar eclipse occurs over China, one of the earliest recorded in human history, reportedly resulting in the executions of two astronomers who failed to predict it.
